name: Sleepy Duskywing
desc: Sleepy Duskywing (Erynnis brizo): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 9 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Erynnis brizo, the sleepy duskywing or banded oak duskywing, is a species of Hesperiidae butterfly that occurs throughout North America and is commonly confused with E. juvenalis and E. lucilius.
